blocks.name: Frieza (final form)
blocks.notes: Cells are on the #47ffbb/#34bc88 checkerboard; the sheet surround is #2a966c and block borders/empty cells are #237f5a - treat all four as transparent. 25 columns in every row; the up row has no blink cell (up col 1 is empty), so idle uses col 0 there and blink has no up entry. Order: 0 idle, 1 blink, 2-5 walk (step, pass, step, pass), then three 4-frame melee strings (wind-up, strike, follow-through, recover) with white swoosh trails baked in: 6-9 backhand swipe, 10-13 straight punch, 14-17 low tail-assisted sweep kick (the third string is the kick, so punch3 and kick share 14-17). 18-20 one-hand ki shot (18 low lunge with the hand thrust forward, 19 palm raised, 20 palm pushed further out; 19 and 20 use the same hand). 21 hurt flinch with a white hit spark above the head (it is the col-24 pose plus the spark). 22-23 block with forearms raised across the face and head bowed (22 carries the block spark, 23 is the held pose). 24 tensed fists-clenched power-up stance (the engine aura goes on top). The sheet has NO flying, knocked-down or arms-raised frames: fly reuses idle (0), ko reuses the hurt flinch (21) and raise reuses the punch2 wind-up (10, fist raised beside the head). Palette: skin is his white body; carapace is the purple dome, shoulders, forearms and shins; #ffffff is also the colour of the swoosh trails and sparks; #7b63ad is the darkest body shade and also rims the dome. The baked ground shadow under the feet is #000000, the same colour as outlines/eyes, so strip it by geometry (the engine draws its own), never by colour.
